title: Fiskerton Airfield — 49 Squadron Memorial
memorial_address: Former RAF Fiskerton airfield, Fiskerton, Lincolnshire
narrative: RAF Fiskerton in Lincolnshire was a Bomber Command Lancaster base, home to 49 Squadron during the height of the strategic bombing campaign. The airfield site — now largely returned to agricultural use — retains a memorial on its former ground. The 49 Squadron Association returns to this site annually for Remembrance Sunday services, alongside a companion service at St Clement's Church in the village of Fiskerton. The annual return of veterans and their families to the former operational base reflects the deep bond between the squadron community and the Lincolnshire landscape over which they flew.
memorial_details: Memorial on the former RAF Fiskerton airfield site. 49 Squadron Association holds annual Remembrance Sunday services here and at St Clement's Church, Fiskerton. The airfield site is now largely agricultural land.
